name: relationship-ledger
description: Use the active Workspace Relationship Ledger as the durable source for identities, contact routes, relationship state, interactions, follow-ups, consent, and evidence.

invocation_policy.semantic_trigger: the active Workspace has the Relationship Ledger installed and the request requires reading, querying, changing, reconciling, or relying on CRM-style relationship data such as people, organizations, contacts, leads, customers, partners, vendors, investors, outreach, replies, follow-ups, meetings, consent, bounce, unsubscribe, do-not-contact, or duplicate identity state, regardless of language
